title: National Bison Legacy Act
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was reported to the House on April 12, 2016. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

National Bison Legacy Act

(Sec. 3) This bill adopts the North American bison as the national mammal of the United States.

summary.headline: This law names the North American bison the national mammal of the United States.
summary.what_it_does: The act formally adopts the North American bison as the national mammal of the United States. It is a symbolic designation and does not create new programs, funding, or rules. The summary does not describe any other effects.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on May 9, 2016.
